comments.author: Caddy
comments.body:
Purchased from Immigration NPC "Letizia" (spelling may differ on our server) at company colonies for 500k per unit. To have a chance to attract this NPC to your colony, you must do the correct immigration quests.

Ticket contents are mostly battle-related consumable items, including:
Tercio's Defence x1 (same exact effect/stats as Hawk's Wings)
Chicken Paella x28 (+55 vig/fatigue food)
Smoke Bomb of Retreat x1
Memo of Skill Use x1 (1 hour version)
Afternoon Tea Set x1
Navy Dispatch Request x1
Canned Seafood Pizza x1
Reinforcement Order x5
Disaster Kit Chest x1
Large Ship Blueprint: Piece x1
